interface.reset: No reset port exists in the original interface.

semantics.clock: Original problem: all sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.
semantics.shift: When shift_ena=1, shift toward higher bit indices and insert data into bit 0. Sending b3,b2,b1,b0 produces q=b3b2b1b0, as required by MSB-first input.
semantics.count: When shift_ena=0 and count_ena=1, decrement the current four-bit register on that edge.
semantics.hold: With both enables zero, retain the register value.
semantics.simultaneous: Original problem explicitly allows arbitrary behavior when both enables are one. Implementation selects shift priority; oracle does not constrain that case.
semantics.initialization: Original specifies no initialization or reset. RTL supplies neither; simulation starts unknown and four shifts establish a known word.
semantics.latency: q updates at the accepting rising edge through a nonblocking register assignment, with no additional pipeline.

numeric.decrement: Modulo 16 subtraction; zero becomes 15 under four-bit arithmetic.
numeric.serial_order: First of four supplied bits becomes bit 3.

verification.oracle: Derived from original prose: collect four serial bits MSB-first to load each integer 0..15, then compare direct integer decrements modulo 16.
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges, verify hold before rising edge and compare after the nonblocking update; also verify falling-edge stability.
verification.coverage: Startup unknown and partial serial loading, all 16 loads, hold with changing data, every count state and repeated wraparound, interleaved shifts and counts.
verification.infrastructure: Smoke fixture gate, structural contract gate, then python3 dev_check.py --label initial.
verification.termination: Fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, and PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: No initial value or reset is specified
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No synthesized initialization; do not require a particular hardware startup value. Check natural unknown simulation and convergence after four input bits.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: It does not matter what your circuit does if both control inputs are 1
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Shift priority chosen; not tested as a required behavior.
